AssistantSettings.title: AssistantSettings
AssistantSettings.description: Configuration for the user's AI Call Assistant behavior, greeting, language, and importance criteria.

assistantEnabled.description: Whether the AI Call Assistant is active.

assistantLanguage.description: Language used by AI voice assistant.

assistantName.description: Display name of the AI assistant.

importanceRules.description: Custom rules describing what makes a call urgent or important.

notifyUrgentOnly.description: If true, send high-priority notifications only for urgent calls.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when settings were created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when settings were last updated.

VipContact.title: VipContact
VipContact.description: A VIP or blocked contact rule configured by the user.

phoneNumber.description: Phone number or caller ID pattern.

priorityLevel.description: Priority or block level for this caller.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when contact rule was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when contact rule was updated.

CallLog.title: CallLog
CallLog.description: Screened or AI-answered call transcript, summary, and importance assessment.

aiSummary.description: Concise AI summary of the call.

transcript.description: Full conversation transcript between AI and caller.

actionTaken.description: Action taken by the AI assistant.

durationSeconds.description: Duration of the call conversation in seconds.

notifiedUser.description: Whether a priority notification was dispatched.

acknowledged.description: Whether the user has reviewed/acknowledged this call.

isSimulated.description: Whether this call log came from an in-app AI voice test.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when call log was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when call log was updated.

/users/{userId}/vip_contacts/{contactId}.description: User-scoped VIP and blocked caller rules.

/users/{userId}/call_logs/{callId}.description: User-scoped AI call transcripts and importance logs.
